sentences.zh: 在那之前，没有人知道她计划退出关税同盟和单一市场。

sentences.en: ends free movement, protects jobs, security and our union, or leave with no deal or no Brexit at all.
sentences.zh: （注：此条为空，根据输入补齐）

sentences.en: And it went over like a lead balloon.
sentences.zh: （注：此条为空，根据输入补齐）

sentences.en: And why was that?
sentences.zh: （注：此条为空，根据输入补齐）

sentences.en: Well, she laid out a series of red lines that were in fact very hard Brexit red lines.
sentences.zh: （注：此条为空，根据输入补齐）

sentences.en: No one knew up until that point that she was planning to exit the customs union and the single market.
sentences.zh: （注：此条为空，根据输入补齐）

sentences.en: And because we will no longer be members of the single market, we will not be required to contribute huge sums to the EU budget.
sentences.zh: 因为我们将不再是单一市场的成员，所以我们无需再向欧盟预算缴纳巨额款项。

sentences.en: The days of Britain making vast contributions to the European Union every year will end.
sentences.zh: 英国每年向欧盟支付巨额贡献的日子将一去不复返。

sentences.en: And why is that ultimately a blunder?
sentences.zh: 那为什么这最终成了一个大错呢？

sentences.en: Well, they had no solution for what would turn out to be the fatal problem with that plan, which is Britain is not an island.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们对于那个计划中致命的问题毫无对策，那就是英国并非一座岛屿。

sentences.en: There is a land border between the Republic of Ireland and Northern Ireland.
sentences.zh: 爱尔兰共和国和北爱尔兰之间存在陆地边界。

sentences.en: And you cannot just walk away from the customs union without creating some kind of a border.
sentences.zh: 如果不建立某种形式的边界，你不可能就这样退出关税同盟。

sentences.en: And of course, that open border between Northern Ireland and the Republic had been the subject of a 30-year armed struggle and a hard-fought peace agreement.
sentences.zh: 当然，北爱尔兰和爱尔兰共和国之间的开放边界，曾是三十年武装斗争和来之不易的和平协议的主题。

sentences.en: So to gloss over it was sort of not looking at the problem, which was going to block this thing at the end.
sentences.zh: 所以，对它轻描淡写就等于无视问题，而这终将成为阻碍此事的绊脚石。

sentences.en: The choices before us were difficult, particularly in relation to the Northern Ireland backstop.
sentences.zh: 我们面临的选择很艰难，尤其是在涉及北爱尔兰“保障条款”的问题上。

sentences.en: But the way she squared the circle with the Irish border is to create something called the backstop.
sentences.zh: 但她解决爱尔兰边界难题的方法是创造了一个所谓的“保障条款”。

sentences.en: And what the backstop means is that the entire of the UK would remain in the customs union until
sentences.zh: “保障条款”意味着整个英国将留在关税同盟内，直到

sentences.en: such a time that there is a solution to the border problem, which could easily be never.
sentences.zh: 边界问题得到解决，而这可能永远都不会发生。

sentences.en: And this is why she lost her Brexiteers, because they said, well, this is just a way for us to stay in the
sentences.zh: 这就是她失去脱欧派支持的原因，因为他们说，这只是让我们留在

sentences.en: European Union subject to their regulations indefinitely, because there is no provision for the United Kingdom leaving the backstop unilaterally.
sentences.zh: 欧盟并无限期受其法规约束的一种方式，因为英国没有单方面退出保障条款的条款。

sentences.en: So they just saw themselves as being stuck at the mercy of Europe indefinitely.
sentences.zh: 所以他们认为自己被无限期地困在了欧洲的摆布之下。

sentences.en: Well, that's the first time I understood the backstop.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这是我第一次理解“保障条款”。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: The fact is that her deal isn't really a deal, because what it actually does is postpone everything.
sentences.zh: 事实是，她的协议根本算不上协议，因为它实际上只是推迟了一切。

sentences.en: It doesn't settle anything.
sentences.zh: 它什么问题也没解决。

sentences.en: It actually guarantees more uncertainty, which is terrible for business.
sentences.zh: 它实际上保证了更多的不确定性，这对商业来说是极其糟糕的。

sentences.en: And it's not even Brexit.
sentences.zh: 而且这甚至算不上脱欧。

sentences.en: It is not Brexit at all.
sentences.zh: 这根本不是脱欧。

sentences.en: And they're pretending that it is.
sentences.zh: 而他们却假装这就是脱欧。

sentences.en: So what she begins to do is try to persuade the country to compromise.
sentences.zh: 于是她开始尝试说服全国达成妥协。

sentences.en: But it is extremely late in the game.
sentences.zh: 但现在为时已晚。

sentences.en: And she hasn't laid the groundwork for a compromise.
sentences.zh: 而且她并没有为妥协打好基础。

sentences.en: Much of her energy went to keeping the hardliners on side.
sentences.zh: 她的大部分精力都花在了安抚强硬派上。

sentences.en: And as soon as she published her withdrawal agreement, she lost them.
sentences.zh: 而就在她公布脱欧协议后，她失去了他们的支持。

sentences.en: Theresa May still believes there's a battle to be won in Brussels.
sentences.zh: 特蕾莎·梅仍然相信在布鲁塞尔还有一场硬仗要打。

sentences.en: A growing number of British MPs don't.
sentences.zh: 但越来越多的英国议员不这么认为。

sentences.en: The view from Europe is of a nation increasingly at odds with itself.
sentences.zh: 欧洲眼中的英国，是一个日益与自身矛盾的国家。

sentences.en: And how does May respond to all these condemnations and men who are essentially beating her up?
sentences.zh: 面对所有这些谴责和那些本质上在攻击她的男人们，梅又是如何回应的呢？

sentences.en: I mean, this is such an irritating, maddening group of people that, I don't know, a lot of Britons during
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是一群如此令人恼火、令人抓狂的人，以至于我不知道，很多英国人在

sentences.en: this period, their heart kind of went out to her, because any normal person would just throw their hands up and walk away from this nightmare of a job.
sentences.zh: 这段时期，内心其实很同情她，因为任何正常人都会选择放弃，远离这份噩梦般的工作。

sentences.en: But she'd just wake up in the morning and dust herself off and set aside her personal feelings and say,
sentences.zh: 但她每天早上醒来，拍拍身上的灰尘，放下个人情感，说道：

sentences.en: I believe with every fiber of my being that the course I have set out is the right one for our country and all our people.
sentences.zh: “我坚信，我所设定的道路对我们的国家和所有人民来说是正确的。”

sentences.en: Again and again.
sentences.zh: 一次又一次。

sentences.en: From the very beginning, I have known what I wanted to deliver for the British people to honor their vote in the referendum.
sentences.zh: “从一开始，我就知道我想为英国人民实现什么，以尊重他们在公投中的投票。”

sentences.en: I have committed to delivering Brexit to the British people.
sentences.zh: “我致力于为英国人民实现脱欧。”

sentences.en: The British people just want us to get on with it.
sentences.zh: “英国人民只想让我们继续推进。”

sentences.en: They are looking to the Conservative Party to deliver.
sentences.zh: “他们指望保守党能有所作为。”

sentences.en: To deliver a Brexit that works for the whole UK.
sentences.zh: “实现一个对整个英国都有利的脱欧。”

sentences.en: And that's what I'm going to do.
sentences.zh: “这就是我要做的。”

sentences.en: I'm going to do my job of getting the best deal for Britain.
sentences.zh: “我会做好我的工作，为英国争取最好的协议。”

sentences.en: I'm going to do my job of getting a deal that is in the national intereSt.
sentences.zh: “我会做好我的工作，争取达成符合国家利益的协议。”

sentences.en: She's stuck with it and she's stuck with it and she seemed unwilling to give up.
sentences.zh: 她坚持了下来，她一直坚持着，似乎不愿放弃。

sentences.en: And am I going to see this through?
sentences.zh: “我会坚持到底吗？”

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: “是的。”

sentences.en: Until last week.
sentences.zh: 直到上周。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用一个月，且无需绑定信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用内的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月时间越过付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，获取30天免费访问权限。

sentences.en: So bring us back to this committee room, number 14.
sentences.zh: 那么，带我们回到这个14号委员会会议室。

sentences.en: What do we know about what Theresa May said as she offered her own head to members of the Conservative Party as this final gesture?
sentences.zh: 关于特蕾莎·梅在向保守党成员献出自己的职位作为最后姿态时所说的话，我们了解多少？

sentences.en: This was the way it was described by George Freeman, who was her former policy advisor.
sentences.zh: 这是她的前政策顾问乔治·弗里曼对当时情况的描述。

sentences.en: She, with tears not far from her eyes, said,
sentences.zh: 她眼含泪水，说道：

sentences.en: After she finished speaking in this committee room, there were several MPs who were kind of hardline, holdout Brexiteers,
sentences.zh: 在她在这个委员会会议室发言结束后，有几位强硬派、坚守立场的脱欧派议员，

sentences.en: who got up and said publicly that they were now going to back her deal.
sentences.zh: 站起来公开表示他们现在要支持她的协议。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: So this seems to be working.
sentences.zh: 所以这似乎奏效了。

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: For the next, like, I don't know, 45 minutes to an hour,
sentences.zh: 在接下来的，大概，我不知道，45分钟到一个小时里，

sentences.en: journalists were on Twitter just counting the number of Brexiteers that were changing sides.
sentences.zh: 记者们在推特上统计着倒戈的脱欧派人数。

sentences.en: And you had people like Boris Johnson, who, you know, I think he had compared her deal to a suicide vest at one point.
sentences.zh: 还有像鲍里斯·约翰逊这样的人，你知道，我想他曾一度把她的协议比作自杀背心。

sentences.en: This is what he said to the Daily Telegraph.
sentences.zh: 这是他对《每日电讯报》说的话。

sentences.en: I feel very, very sorry, and though it fills me with pain, I'm going to have to support this thing.
sentences.zh: “我感到非常、非常遗憾，虽然这让我痛苦，但我不得不支持这个东西。”

sentences.en: So he flipped sides.
sentences.zh: 所以他倒戈了。

sentences.en: Jacob Rees-Mogg, another kind of Brexiteer bannerman, tweeted out that half a loaf is better than no bread.
sentences.zh: 雅各布·里斯-莫格，另一位脱欧派旗手，发推文说“半块面包总比没有好”。

sentences.en: In other words, he was willing to give up some of his Brexiteer credibility to get behind Theresa May and give her his vote.
sentences.zh: 换句话说，他愿意放弃一些脱欧派的信誉来支持特蕾莎·梅并投她一票。

sentences.en: And you just began to see this happening again and again.
sentences.zh: 你开始看到这种情况一次又一次地发生。

sentences.en: They were flipping, and I think it got up to something like 30 or 40 people were indicating that they were changing sides.
sentences.zh: 他们正在倒戈，我想人数达到了大约30到40人，表示他们正在改变立场。

sentences.en: And it looked somehow that at this last moment, in this last kind of Hail Mary pass that she had thrown, by offering her resignation, she might have just gotten it over the line.
sentences.zh: 看起来在最后一刻，在她孤注一掷的最后尝试中，通过提出辞职，她可能真的让协议通过了。

sentences.en: Order!
sentences.zh: 肃静！

sentences.en: Order!
sentences.zh: 肃静！

sentences.en: But sometime after 3 o'clock on Friday, March 29th...
sentences.zh: 但在3月29日星期五下午3点过后不久……

sentences.en: The ayes to the right, 286.
sentences.zh: 赞成票在右侧，286票。

sentences.en: The no's to the left, 344.
sentences.zh: 反对票在左侧，344票。

sentences.en: So the no's have it, the no's have it.
sentences.zh: 所以反对票获胜，反对票获胜。

sentences.en: Parliament rejected her withdrawal agreement for the third time by a vote of 344 to 286.
sentences.zh: 议会以344票对286票，第三次否决了她的脱欧协议。

sentences.en: So she just fell short.
sentences.zh: 所以她还是功亏一篑。

sentences.en: Yep, she fell short.
sentences.zh: 是的，她功亏一篑。

sentences.en: Point of order, the Prime Minister.
sentences.zh: 程序问题，首相。

sentences.en: Point of order, Mr. Speaker.
sentences.zh: 程序问题，议长先生。

sentences.en: Mr. Speaker, I think it should be a matter of profound regret to every member of this House
sentences.zh: 议长先生，我认为本院每一位议员都应深感遗憾，

sentences.en: that once again we have been unable to support leaving the European Union in an orderly fashion.
sentences.zh: 因为我们再次未能支持以有序的方式离开欧盟。

sentences.en: The implications of the House's decision are grave.
sentences.zh: 本院决定的影响是严重的。

sentences.en: So this offer to give up her own prime ministership in exchange for Brexit, essentially Parliament said to her, not even that is enough.
sentences.zh: 所以，她以放弃首相职位为代价换取脱欧的提议，议会本质上对她说，即使这样也不够。

sentences.en: It wasn't enough.
sentences.zh: 这还不够。

sentences.en: Good evening from Westminster.
sentences.zh: 威斯敏斯特晚安。

sentences.en: If the prime minister had had her way, the United Kingdom would be leaving the EU in one hour's time.
sentences.zh: 如果首相如愿以偿，英国本应在一小时后离开欧盟。

sentences.en: Today should have been Brexit day.
sentences.zh: 今天本应是脱欧日。

sentences.en: That's what Theresa May had promised.
sentences.zh: 那是特蕾莎·梅承诺过的。

sentences.en: But instead...
sentences.zh: 但相反……

sentences.en: And this is the kind of absurd trap that we've all been in, that here's an impossible task that doesn't get done and doesn't get done.
sentences.zh: 这就是我们一直身陷其中的荒谬陷阱，一个不可能完成的任务，却迟迟无法完成。

sentences.en: And yet nothing changes.
sentences.zh: 然而什么都没有改变。

sentences.en: There's no off-ramp.
sentences.zh: 没有出口。

sentences.en: And so Brexit still isn't done, and Theresa May is still the person in charge of it.
sentences.zh: 所以脱欧仍然没有完成，而特蕾莎·梅仍然是负责人。

sentences.en: I mean, you sort of imagine that she was ready to walk away, and you could see it on her face.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，你可能会想象她已经准备好离开了，你可以从她的脸上看出来。

sentences.en: She looked like a different person.
sentences.zh: 她看起来像变了一个人。

sentences.en: She looked younger.
sentences.zh: 她看起来更年轻了。

sentences.en: She looked...
sentences.zh: 她看起来……

sentences.en: I don't know.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: She just didn't look strained anymore.
sentences.zh: 她看起来不再那么紧绷了。

sentences.en: But actually, she's not free.
sentences.zh: 但实际上，她并不自由。

sentences.en: It's not done.
sentences.zh: 事情还没结束。

sentences.en: And she's going to have to start all over again in the morning.
sentences.zh: 明天早上她还得从头开始。

sentences.en: Ellen, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 艾伦，非常感谢。

sentences.en: We appreciate it.
sentences.zh: 我们很感激。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: I've ended payments to Guatemala, to Honduras, and to El Salvador.
sentences.zh: “我已经终止了对危地马拉、洪都拉斯和萨尔瓦多的援助支付。”

sentences.en: No money goes there anymore.
sentences.zh: “那里不再有钱了。”

sentences.en: Over the weekend, the Trump administration said it would drastically cut financial aid to three Central American countries.
sentences.zh: 周末，特朗普政府表示将大幅削减对三个中美洲国家的财政援助。

sentences.en: In retaliation for what he said was their failure to stop the flow of migrants to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 以报复他所说的这些国家未能阻止移民流向美国。

sentences.en: border.
sentences.zh: 边境。

sentences.en: We were paying them tremendous amounts of money, and we're not paying them anymore because they haven't done a thing for us.
sentences.zh: “我们曾支付给他们巨额资金，但我们不再支付了，因为他们对我们什么都没做。”

sentences.en: The $500 million in aid to El Salvador, Guatemala, and Honduras was originally designed to address
sentences.zh: 这5亿美元对萨尔瓦多、危地马拉和洪都拉斯的援助，最初旨在解决

sentences.en: the root cause of migration, violence, lack of jobs, and poverty, and its elimination could ultimately backfire, triggering even more migration to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 移民的根源问题：暴力、缺乏就业和贫困，而取消援助最终可能会适得其反，引发更多流向美国的移民。

sentences.en: And New York will become the first city in the country to charge drivers for using its streets in an attempt to reduce congestion and raise money to repair its subway system.
sentences.zh: 纽约将成为全国第一个对在街道上行驶的司机收费的城市，旨在减少拥堵并筹集资金修复地铁系统。

sentences.en: You have to get fewer cars driving into Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 你必须减少开车进入曼哈顿的车辆。

sentences.en: The traffic is so bad.
sentences.zh: 交通太糟糕了。

sentences.en: I can't tell you how many days myself.
sentences.zh: 我数不清有多少天我自己也是这样。

sentences.en: I just get out of the car and walk because it's so much faster.
sentences.zh: 我干脆下车走路，因为那样快得多。

sentences.en: Under a plan adopted by Governor Andrew Cuomo and the state legislature on Sunday, drivers will be charged a fee of at least $10 to drive below 60th Street in Manhattan.
sentences.zh: 根据州长安德鲁·科莫和州议会周日通过的计划，司机在曼哈顿60街以下行驶将至少被收取10美元的费用。

sentences.en: Buses in Manhattan, I think the average is now down to like four miles per hour.
sentences.zh: 曼哈顿的公交车，我想现在的平均速度已经降到了每小时4英里左右。

sentences.en: The fees, known as congestion pricing, are already in use in London, Stockholm, and Singapore, where they have cut both traffic and air pollution.
sentences.zh: 这种被称为“拥堵费”的收费方式已经在伦敦、斯德哥尔摩和新加坡实施，它们既减少了交通流量，也降低了空气污染。

sentences.en: In New York, they are expected to raise $1 billion a year for the city's subway system.
sentences.zh: 在纽约，预计每年可为城市地铁系统筹集10亿美元。

sentences.en: And it's a little bit of a chicken and an egg.
sentences.zh: 这有点像“先有鸡还是先有蛋”的问题。

sentences.en: You need a viable, functioning mass transit system so people get out of their cars and feel comfortable taking the mass transit system.
sentences.zh: 你需要一个可行、高效的公共交通系统，这样人们才会放弃开车，并乐于使用公共交通系统。

sentences.en: And that's the point behind congestion pricing.
sentences.zh: 这就是拥堵费背后的意义所在。

sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: This week on The Wirecutter Show, we're getting ready for hosting over the holidays.
sentences.zh: 本周在《Wirecutter》节目中，我们正在为假期接待客人做准备。

sentences.en: Tune in for tips on making your guests feel at home.
sentences.zh: 收听节目，获取让客人感到宾至如归的秘诀。

sentences.en: Are they a blackout sleeper?
sentences.zh: 他们是需要全黑环境才能入睡的人吗？

sentences.en: I don't mean do they blackout to go to sleep.
sentences.zh: 我不是指他们是否会昏睡过去。

sentences.en: I mean, what kind of light do they require?
sentences.zh: 我是说，他们需要什么样的光线？

sentences.en: Because that is a very specific thing.
sentences.zh: 因为这是一个非常具体的问题。

sentences.en: Do they have allergies, food sensitivities?
sentences.zh: 他们有过敏症或食物敏感吗？

sentences.en: Are they coffee tea drinkers?
sentences.zh: 他们喝咖啡还是喝茶？

sentences.en: What time do they like to get up?
sentences.zh: 他们喜欢几点起床？

sentences.en: Find The Wirecutter Show on the New York Times app or wherever you like to listen.
sentences.zh: 在《纽约时报》应用或你喜欢的任何播客平台收听《Wirecutter》节目。
